programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A million dollar winner returns to find her forever home in Pensacola, Fla.; with her daughter along on the search, this duo brings David a challenge to help find their dream place where she can retire.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer's hunt for wild continues as he takes a peek inside a Brooklyn brownstone for sale and gets an update on a previous season's Wild House. Later, he travels to Reunion, Florida, to tour a themed home with special guest David Bromstad.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: After losing money on their last home, new parents with twins struggle to find another place for their family in the San Francisco Bay Area. He wants something that's zero stress and move-in ready, but she wants a funky house with character.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A real estate agent is moving out of his family's home and buying his first place in Wilmington, Delaware. He's looking for a historic home downtown, but his carpenter brother thinks something updated and just outside the city would be a better option.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: A Smooth Landing in South Carolina
programs.desc: An airline pilot and his wife look to upsize into a home where they can host family and future grandchildren in Greer, South Carolina. She wants a classic-looking home no matter the cost, but he's worried she'll break the bank.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A couple decides to buy their first home together in Columbus, Ohio; it's a hot market, and she wants to move fast, but he's an engineer and prefers to take his time to make sure they find the right place.
